name: Unrestricted LP333 p37q3 six-coordinate escape anneal
hypothesis: Periodic atomic three-swap proposals may cross exact-PAF barriers that reject every intermediate one-swap state and reach a directly verifiable Legendre pair inside the correct prescribed length-37 pq2 slice.
evidence_unit: one deterministic 3600-second run from seed 20260727 with all 74 correct p37q3 margins, the exact squared PAF objective, 2000000 proposals per restart, and every eighth proposal replaced by three sequential same-column swaps accepted or rejected atomically
claim_boundary: The coordinated-neighborhood motivation comes from a different compressed landscape and transfers no quantitative rate. Only a serialized zero objective independently verifying both full rows, the exact length-37 compression, and all 332 nonzero PAF equations is a candidate.

baseline.evidence: The corrected single-swap p37q3 arm has source SHA-256 7a3bf72d06023658850d9e95ebc4d4eb0b3ba885da6d748a78abd5c297df486d and the identical seed reconstructs initial objective 87904.
baseline.measurement: The active corrected baseline reached best objective 7456, L1 residual 912, and maximum absolute residual 16 in its first 60 seconds.

intervention.one_change: Keep seven of every eight proposals as one exact same-column opposite-sign swap, but make every eighth proposal an atomic composition of three such swaps, affecting at most six coordinates across the two rows.
forbidden_confounds: accepting a nonzero or unaudited state

controls.name: factorization-and-seed-identity
controls.purpose: Bind the mechanism to the corrected slice.
controls.expected: Verify 333=37*3^2 and compressed combined energy 650 with nonzero combined PAF -18 before search.

controls.name: matched-initial-state
controls.purpose: Bind the new mechanism to the baseline start.
controls.expected: Seed 20260727 reconstructs objective 87904, L1 residual 3096, maximum residual 72, and all 74 correct margins.

controls.name: mixed-delta-self-test
controls.purpose: Detect incorrect atomic composition of incremental PAF updates.
controls.expected: Across 2000 deterministic mixed proposals, including every eighth as three swaps, every stored PAF and objective equals a fresh O(333^2) recomputation and all 74 margins remain exact.

controls.name: mechanism-telemetry
controls.purpose: Prove the intervention fired at its frozen cadence.
controls.expected: The companion result records period 8, six coordinates, self-test PASS, and triple-swap proposals equal floor(total proposals divided by 8).

controls.name: independent-full-result-audit
controls.purpose: Recompute the endpoint outside the C implementation.
controls.expected: The Python bit-rotation auditor recomputes both PAF vectors, all 74 margins, row sums, objective, L1, maximum residual, compression rows, and candidate status.

controls.name: source-and-binary-pin
controls.purpose: Bind both the intervention and its included corrected baseline.
controls.expected: Intervention source SHA-256 029ef4f8b64726001c253f1b404da9cf5fc262fba48f6038cd813e1c7c3d3a1f, included baseline SHA-256 7a3bf72d06023658850d9e95ebc4d4eb0b3ba885da6d748a78abd5c297df486d, binary SHA-256 2a65c1c207da40caa57a6b2d566af3a53d1e299d07abc2836e5203ea41210403.

primary_metric.name: independently verified exact squared PAF residual reaches zero

terminal_outcomes.promote: The best squared residual is zero and the independent audit verifies the prescribed compression and all 332 nonzero combined PAF equations.
terminal_outcomes.park: The frozen schedule completes with valid cadence telemetry and an independently audited nonzero endpoint.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: A process, memory, artifact, or verification ceiling interrupts the frozen schedule before its endpoint is written and audited.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any factorization, seed identity, matched start, mixed delta, cadence, source pin, binary pin, stored-score, full PAF, or candidate-status control fails.

stop_rules: Run only the pinned source and binary at seed 20260727.
Use 2000000 proposals per restart, the 512-to-0.25 cooling schedule, and exactly one triple-swap proposal every eight proposals.
Stop immediately at exact zero objective.
Otherwise stop at 3600 seconds without another seed, frequency, temperature, restart length, or cap.
Run the independent bit-rotation audit before interpretation.
Do not promote a lower nonzero score.

next_actions.promote: Freeze the pair, run a second direct LP audit, construct H668, verify orthogonality and artifact hashes, and package it for the gated submission workflow.
next_actions.park: Archive and retire this exact cadence; use its endpoint only as workload characterization.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the interruption and resume only the remaining frozen wall budget if reproducible.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest factorization, source, cadence, delta, serialization, or verifier defect.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts, source-pinned code, and public technical literature are authorized for the eight-hour autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared for submission; an actual external form action remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
